what_is_it.explanation: TokenEconomizer is a plugin designed to lower the recurring costs of running coding agents on a repository. Without altering the underlying model, weights, or code of the agent, it learns across multiple sessions to prune unused tools, manage repeated facts, and guard against failing loops.
